verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an official CLI for document conversion (datalab-docs-14, datalab-probe-3), and a runtime probe confirms it actually works — installing the Python SDK keylessly and running `datalab --help` produced a real CLI usage surface, with the underlying API cleanly auth-gated (datalab-probe-rt-1). This is first-party plus hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: no independent (non-vendor) third-party review of the CLI's full command surface beyond the single probe.
